method: Isolated exact native HK Brief paragraph typography A/B, changing only parent/current font declarations and assets; browser loads all applicable faces then prepares fonts. interpretation: Both partitions use custom Noto Sans TC for all 66 CJK glyphs. New font-face boundaries change contextual text shaping/wrapping despite identical original outlines and advances; no clipping or dropped content. Disabling chws/palt/kerning in a control does not remove this partition-dependent difference; no specific OpenType feature is claimed as its cause.
